facts.fact: ITWeb reports that POPIA came into force on 1 July 2021 after a year-long grace period for organisations to comply.

The chairperson says the Regulator has moved from establishing the framework to exercising statutory enforcement powers, including receiving complaints, conducting assessments and issuing enforcement notices; no figures or named decisions are given (document published 2026-09-17, no event date).

ITWeb reports that the Information Regulator was established on 1 December 2016 to monitor and enforce compliance with POPIA and PAIA, and that its chairperson Pansy Tlakula and executives were speaking for it in September 2026.
